_source: Compared with the sandbox's job/node_trace.py (DECISION_TYPES and normalize_decision) at local-mailroom-sandbox commit 900c38a: the seven keys, their order and the three types are identical. Refresh it from that file when the sandbox schema changes; test_fixture_matches_the_sandbox_node_trace_when_a_checkout_is_given re-checks it against a checkout (MAILROOM_SANDBOX_CHECKOUT).
known_value_differences: source: the sandbox keeps only 'agent' or 'decisions'; this repo records the node that made the decision (e.g. 'classify').
expected: the sandbox means the expected score (a number); this repo records the ground-truth class (a string) for doc_type decisions.
options: the sandbox means per-option probabilities (a mapping); this repo lists the doc types it chose from (a list).
